4. င်ဤ၏ခင်းတွင်ပုတ်ပုတ်သည်ကြောင်းရာတွင်ပုတ်ပုတ်မည်။

These incidents are usually recorded as accident reports. Employees are asked to record as many details as possible: the number of people involved, the type of accident, the location and time
